cards.card_text: The next morning, the word of the LORD comes, and God brings up the question the rebellious house asked Ezekiel: 'What are you doing?' Fair question, and I'd have asked it while he was still elbow-deep in the wall.
cards.verse_text: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, hasn’t the rebellious house of Israel asked you, ‘What are you doing?’
cards.snippet: …of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, hasn’t the rebellious house of Israel asked you, ‘What are you doing?’

cards.card_text: The word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel again, and God tells him to ask this rebellious house, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Then God explains it, and friend, I am SO relieved.
cards.verse_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Now say to this rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, carried off its king and officials, and brought them back with him to Babylon.
cards.snippet: …word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Now say to this rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold,…

cards.snippet: …the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.

cards.card_text: Now he turns to one more city: "Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!" Friend, when a prophet's been calling out every city on the map and then says ONE MORE, nobody in the room is breathing.
cards.verse_text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
cards.snippet: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

cards.card_text: Paul says the law is for the lawless and rebellious, and he keeps going down a long list: the ungodly and sinful, murderers, the sexually immoral, slave traders, liars and more.
cards.verse_text: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers, for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
cards.snippet: …law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers…
